description: This Java source file defines the AlarmService class for an Android application. It demonstrates scheduling and cancelling a repeating alarm that triggers a service after a specified delay, including UI buttons to start and stop the alarm, and displaying Toast messages as user feedback.

classes.name: AlarmService
classes.description: An Android Activity that allows users to schedule and cancel a repeating alarm that triggers a service after a delay.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the AlarmService activity, sets up UI components, and creates a PendingIntent for the alarm.

methods.name: mStartAlarmListener
methods.description: Listener that schedules a repeating alarm to trigger after 30 seconds when the start button is clicked.

methods.name: mStopAlarmListener
methods.description: Listener that cancels the scheduled alarm when the stop button is clicked.
